_note: Manual corrections applied after merging raw files. Verified 2026-11-17 via GitHub commit feeds (scripts/check-repos.mjs) and web search.

elinks.description: Feature-rich text-mode browser with tabs, colours and scripting; maintained as the rkd77 fork.

carbonyl.description: Chromium running inside a terminal, rendering pages with Unicode blocks. No commits since early 2023.

chatgpt-atlas.description: OpenAI's Chromium-based AI browser for macOS. Launched Oct 2025, shut down Aug 9, 2026.

arc.description: Design-led browser with a sidebar, Spaces and Boosts. The Browser Company sunsets it on Dec 22, 2026 in favour of Dia.

google-disco.description: Google Labs experimental Chromium browser for macOS that turns open tabs into Gemini-generated GenTabs apps.

konqueror.description: KDE's long-running file manager and web browser in one, now rendering with QtWebEngine.

ladybird.description: Truly independent browser with its own engine (LibWeb), not based on Chromium, Gecko or WebKit. Pre-alpha; first alpha due late 2026.

pissandshittium.description: Joke Chromium fork with funny UI strings and colours like 'Literal Shit'. Its own FAQ begs you not to daily-drive it.
